title: Workspace rules
subtitle: Set by an administrator for the whole workspace, they take precedence over everyone's individual settings.
readOnlyNote: Only a workspace administrator can change these rules. They are shown here so everyone knows what they restrict.

visibility.label: A unit's accounts
visibility.description: Who sees the accounts attached to an agency, a BU or a team. An account with no unit stays visible to everyone.
visibility.sharedHint: Each person's access level decides, as before.
visibility.privateHint: Only the unit's members see its accounts, even a member set to “whole workspace”. Administrators keep their own setting.

export.label: Who can export
export.description: Everything that takes data out of the workspace — CSV files, downloads (dossiers, contacts, skills files, conversations), exports to a spreadsheet or an external tool —, from the screen as well as from {{copilot}}. Import, share links, sending for signature and logging to the CRM stay open to every member.
export.everyoneHint: Every member whose role or individual grant allows exporting.
export.adminsHint: The owner and administrators. An individual grant is no longer enough: for everyone else, the export buttons disappear.

errorMessage: I couldn't read the workspace's rules.

refusal.exportPolicy: Reserved by the workspace rule: exporting data is reserved to the workspace’s administrators.
refusal.businessUnitAccountsVisibility: Reserved by the workspace rule: this unit’s accounts are visible to its members only.

lauraDefaultMode.title: {{copilot}} — default mode
lauraDefaultMode.subtitle: The context mode a new conversation uses until someone picks another one. This is not a workspace rule: it takes away no right, it only sets a fallback value.
lauraDefaultMode.readOnlyNote: Only a workspace administrator can change this setting.
lauraDefaultMode.label: Default mode for a new conversation
lauraDefaultMode.description: A thread that already received an explicit choice always keeps priority — this setting only applies to new conversations.
lauraDefaultMode.my_activityHint: Profile, portfolio and CRM read — the behavior before this setting.
lauraDefaultMode.one_off_missionHint: Only the conversation's brief and the selected account, if one is scoped.
lauraDefaultMode.neutralHint: Only the request and public sources.

lauraEvalSampling.label: Improve {{copilot}} with anonymized conversations
lauraEvalSampling.description: On by default. Set per workspace: each workspace chooses for itself.
lauraEvalSampling.rowTitle: Send anonymized requests to {{copilot}}’s quality evaluations
lauraEvalSampling.rowDescription: When on, what members ask {{copilot}} is sent to quality evaluations, after names, contact details, links and identifiers are removed. Turning it off deletes what was already sent; samples are deleted after 90 days anyway.
lauraEvalSampling.never: Never sent: the body of a drafted message, an attachment, a voice message, or {{copilot}}’s reply.

workspaceProfile.label: Workspace profile
workspaceProfile.description: How your firm works with its clients. In fixed-price mode the navigation is organised around projects to scope and follow: staffing moves to the background. Chosen when the workspace is created, editable here — and nowhere else.
workspaceProfile.staffingHint: You place consultants at your clients: the navigation stays the original one.
workspaceProfile.forfait_conseilHint: You scope and follow fixed-price projects delivered by the client’s teams: projects come before staffing.
workspaceProfile.notChosen: No profile chosen: the original navigation applies.
workspaceProfile.saveFailed: I could not save the workspace profile.
